brief: The canvas depicts a vast cornfield under a dark sky. Dominating the scene is a glowing, disc-shaped UFO hovering just above the stalks. From the bottom of the disc, two steady vertical beams of bright cyan light emit. These beams are the primary focus, exhibiting a noticeable, rhythmic pulsation that brightens and fades with time, casting pulsing cyan light onto the surrounding foliage. The scene remains atmospheric and steady, emphasizing the cyclical movement of the energy plumes.
